security_notes: No model is described as deployed merely because its package is installed.
Embedding model weights are downloaded at first use; target deployment must cache them and record exact weight hashes before offline activation.
RAG retrieval and E01 generation remain separate stages; every retrieved source carries its source digest.
This manifest is dependency evidence for a candidate runtime, not a security certification or target-rootfs inventory.
The E04 model is a smaller multilingual transformer than potion-multilingual-128M; its model files are included in the packaged cache and bound by SHA-256.

E02, E06 and E12 are implemented with deterministic, versioned Python code and no external ML/statistical package dependencies; their limitations and method identifiers are emitted in runtime results.
E02's POS and named-entity labels are heuristic candidates, not a statistical dependency parser or verified named-entity recognition model.
E12 performs typed-AST formalization and exact rational normalization over a bounded operator set; it is not a general-purpose CAS or theorem prover.
